decisions.decision: The committee will focus on the building itself, leave office-space improvements for future town meetings, and buy new equipment and furnishings only to the extent absolutely required for functionality.
decisions.quote: discussion took place that the committee will focus on the building itself and then leave for future town meetings the opportunity to make improvements in office spaces

decisions.decision: The architects will deliver a revised cost estimate to the committee on February 12, and the committee could meet on February 17.
decisions.quote: the architects plan to deliver a revised cost estimate to the committee on february 12th and the committee could meet on february 17th.

decisions.decision: Greg Roy will draft a communication to the select board about the Lions Club food pantry question and circulate it for the next agenda.
decisions.quote: discussion took place to send a communication over to the select board. greg roy stated he would draft something and circulate it so that we have it for next agenda.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The architects presented a preliminary estimate totaling about $21 million, which the committee agreed was far higher than expected.
budget_items.quote: for this preliminary estimate, all these numbers together is 21 million.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The average cost under the preliminary estimate was stated as four hundred and nine dollars a square foot over about 51,400 square feet.
figures_as_printed: four hundred and nine dollars a square foot
fifty one thousand four hundred square feet
budget_items.quote: the average cost for this project with this preliminary estimate is four hundred and nine dollars a square foot based on fifty one thousand four hundred square feet of area.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The estimate includes a building permit fee of about $125,000 payable by the contractor and submitters; waiving it by the town would save that amount.
budget_items.quote: that's probably $125,000 dollars for a building permit fee for this size project

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The estimate assumes three to four percent escalation a year, with a 14-month projection and construction start anticipated May 2022.
budget_items.quote: we are assuming three to four percent of escalation a year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Outside funding for a bronze plaque was presented in connection with the building name; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: also presented was outside funding for a bronze plaque.
